name: isManagementInterfaceHttpsOnly
definition: Plain HTTP and Telnet administration are both disabled on the management interface.
population: the management interface services of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management service settings showing both disable-http and disable-telnet set to yes.
